review_mode: three independent identical holistic PDF-only reviews
consensus_strengths: clear and important hybrid-state ownership problem
explicit lifecycle, storage, and claim-boundary contract
disciplined separation of evidence tiers and memory denominators
coherent narrow factorial and readable figures/tables
consensus_must_fix: independent capture or attestation beyond producer-generated receipts
materially broader concurrent/batched or additional-stack validation
blind or realistic faults and a same-system comparison against strong conventional testing
decision_note: All three reviewers converged on evidence-expansion requirements rather than correctable PDF inconsistencies. A prose-only revision cannot honestly resolve the panel's central concerns. Cross-runtime expansion was not undertaken because the declared paper scope is fixed-runtime feasibility.
